products.code_info: Batch 226 and 227, Manufactured 5/15/2014 and 5/16/2014. Best by dates 5-15-15M1 and 5-16-15M1.
products.reason_for_recall: Manufacturing Solutions International is recalling Cool Tropics Rips Slush, Sour Apple Flavored drinks with the listed BEST BY DATES because finished product laboratory results revealed spoilage type of bacteria and yeasts. The product was released prior to receiving the test results.
